checks.description: loans data must contain all required columns: loan_id, principal_amount, loan_status.
payment_events data must contain all required columns: event_id, payment_id, loan_id, event_type, event_timestamp, amount.
Every event_type value in raw payment_events must be within business_rules.valid_payment_event_types.
Every payment_event.loan_id must reference a loan_id present in raw loans.

INFORMATIONAL ONLY, never fails overall_status: flags payment_ids with more than one SETTLED event. Expected under at-least-once delivery -- the ETL is responsible for collapsing these, not the source for avoiding them.
HARD FAILURE if any payment_id has multiple SETTLED events with different amounts -- ambiguous semantics that must not be silently resolved by picking one.
portfolio_summary.loan_count must match the number of raw loan records.
portfolio_summary.active_loan_count must match the count of raw loans with loan_status == ACTIVE.
portfolio_summary.closed_loan_count must match the count of raw loans with loan_status == CLOSED.
portfolio_summary.defaulted_loan_count must match the count of raw loans with loan_status == DEFAULTED.
portfolio_summary.total_original_principal must match the sum of principal_amount across raw loans.
portfolio_summary.successful_payment_count must match the number of DISTINCT payment_ids with a SETTLED event (entity grain), not the number of SETTLED event rows (source grain).

portfolio_summary.total_successful_payments must match the sum of amount across one SETTLED event per payment_id (the latest, after collapsing exact-replay duplicates), not the sum across every SETTLED row.
portfolio_summary.total_outstanding_balance must match (total_original_principal - entity-grain total_successful_payments), computed independently from raw data.
